# Chronology
Newest first.
The gitboard system evolves through a structured refinement of its operational typology.
### Typology Development
The system moves from initial survey and refinement arcs toward a stable typology architecture. This stage establishes the core organizational patterns for managing GitLab and GitHub code changes, transitioning from raw discovery to a refined state documented in the architecture brief.
### System Discovery
Initial evidence collection and module scoping define the boundaries of the gitboard environment, establishing the local dashboard capabilities for CI status, MR tracking, and worktree state.
